0. 0.1 FOREWORD

This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 27 October 1976, after the draft finalized by the Chemical Engineering Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering Division Council. 0.2 The graphical below: Section Section Section Section Section Section Section symbols have been grouped in seven sections as given
